verdict.rationale: Carta's docs describe OAuth 2.0 with AUTHORIZATION_CODE and CLIENT_CREDENTIALS grants, configurable OAuth scopes, and service accounts scoped to an Investment Firm's Investor API access — the core mechanism for granting third parties (e.g., incorporation partners, law firms) scoped, non-admin access is documented, including law firms/incorporation partners programmatically sending customers to Carta. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of scope granularity in practice, and no detail on revocation/audit controls for third-party grants.
